thread:
maria: Quick sync  overnight we saw another burst of partial-stream responses + client reconnect storms. I'm capturing concrete follow-ups and owners here so we don't lose momentum.

sam: Can we separate immediate mitigations from longer-term work? I want to avoid scope creep in this sprint. :house:

jen: Agreed. Immediate = things we can land as config/alerts/docs in the next 72h. Longer-term = infra+client lib changes.

alex: One quick observation: a subset of traffic still goes through the legacy LB path that uses idle_timeout=300s. That makes mid-chunk disconnects much more likely to show as partials. I'll scope flipping that on canary.

maria: OK. Immediate action items I propose: 1) Add an observable "partial_chunk_event" counter with session and route tags. owner: sam. due: EOD Wed. 2) Enforce LB idle_timeout=45s on canary route. owner: alex. due: tomorrow AM. 3) Add a synthetic test that simulates a mid-chunk socket drop and ensures client retry/backoff tolerates it. owner: jen. due: next Tue. 4) Short alert rule that surfaces partial_chunk_event > 0.3% over 5m. owner: sam. due: EOD Wed.

sam: I'll plant the metric. Proposed name: streaming_partial_chunk_total{session_id,route}. Quick alert idea:
```yaml
alert: PartialChunkSpike
expr: sum(rate(streaming_partial_chunk_total[5m])) / sum(rate(streaming_streams_started_total[5m])) > 0.003
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "Partial chunk rate >0.3%"
```

jen: For the synthetic test I'll add a small harness in infra-tests that opens a stream, tears down socket mid-message, and validates client backoff sequence. I'll include a deterministic timeline so we can assert sleep intervals.

alex: I'll flip the canary LB idle_timeout to 45s and run a 4h soak. ops-bot: please schedule the canary-check job after the change.

ops-bot: @alex acknowledged. Canary job scheduled: https://ci.internal/canary/7910. ETA ~2h.

maria: Great. Acceptance criteria for each: sam -> metric visible in Grafana + failsafe alert on synthetic run; alex -> no partial_chunk events from canary route during 4h soak; jen -> test harness passes in CI and added to regression suite.

sam: added items to the incident follow-up doc with exact alert expr and Grafana panel link. :white_check_mark:

jen: PR drafted for test harness, tests pass locally, will open in the afternoon. acceptance notes are in the PR description.

alex: canary flipped. link posted in follow-up doc. ops-bot: please run the soak verification now.

ops-bot: Canary soak job triggered: https://ci.internal/canary/7910/soak. Results will be posted to the doc.

maria: Longer-term backlog (to triage into roadmap): a) a cross-route session drift detector, b) client library exponential backoff + resume semantics, c) routing policy that pins sessions away from legacy LB. Not for immediate sprint but flagged.

sam: I'll also add a weekly alert that surfaces long-tail timeouts (99.9th pct) and put it on SRE meeting agenda for 2-week review.

maria: Please update the follow-up doc when you hit each acceptance criterion. I'll create cards on the incident board and set a standing 30m sync on Fri 09:30 for 3 weeks. :calendar:

alex: tagging infra-team on the routing changes. small mistake in LB rules can cause session split, so please review when I push.

jen: ack.

maria: Thanks all. If anything regresses push updates here. We'll meet Fri 09:30. ops-bot: set reminder.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: 2539096200 (Fri 09:30) for #incidents  mid-chunk reconnect action sync.
